Vanuatu has achieved several important health outcomes in its short 32 years of

2.2

independence, including improved life expectancy. The MoH states that life expectancy at

birth for males is 67.4 years, and 70.4 years for females, based on 2003 estimates (Government

of Vanuatu, 2011a). WHO (2013) now estimates that life expectancy at birth is 69 years for
